info.title: Lorebase Keeper
info.description: REST API of Lorebase: versioned ontology and knowledge graph. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: The process answers requests. Never touches dependencies.
Dependencies are usable: the database is reachable and migrations are current.
Who the credential of this request belongs to, with the ids grants may name.

post.description:
Create a key bound to a service principal and limited to this Domain.

Unless `principal_id` names an existing service principal, a new one is created and given
`role` in the Domain. The secret in `key` is shown once.
